questions.question: Six persons – A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre. B sits immediate left of A. F is sitting immediate right to A. E is sitting immediately adjacent to F and D. C is sitting immediate right to D. Who among the following is sitting immediately adjacent to A and C?
questions.solution:
Given: Six persons – A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre.

1) B sits immediate left of A.

2) F is sitting immediate right to A.

3) E is sitting immediately adjacent to F and D.

4) C is sitting immediate right to D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04dcc9ef2a5a47e6b63dfd9f741d29ee84e4b9695a34737a3d6196d601d72bf4.png] 

Here, 'B' is sitting immediately adjacent to A and C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in two rows facing each other. Each row has four persons. Q and R are sitting in front of each other. R is the immediate neighbour of S and T. W is sitting to the immediate left of T. W and U are diagonally opposite. V and Q are not next to each other. Who is in front of T?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in two rows facing each other.

Each row has four persons.

1) W is sitting to the immediate left of T.

2) W and U are diagonally opposite. 

3) R is the immediate neighbor of S and T. 

4) Q and R are sitting in front of each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df9985998ccbcf004349bd526ec84785ff3108900faccddbb7ac49d261af6fa6.png] 

5) V and Q are not next to each other (This implies that V will sit at the end of the row).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c81427662eb491614d582d2ea9679d05c2a2eb2cc850f68f7e91af82b55b877.png] 

Here, 'P' is in front of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some trees are fish.

All fishes are goats.

No goat is a flower.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are goats.

II. Some fishes are not flowers.

III. Some flowers are not goats.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some trees are fish.

All fishes are goats.

No goat is a flower.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53c14886d30e50ddd46caf304dbaea669db3dc311aef32d986874534ae464644.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trees are goats - True (Because, Some trees are fish and all fishes are goats, so those part of fish that is trees is also goats).

II. Some fishes are not flowers - True (Because, All fishes are goats and No goat is a flower, so Some fishes are not flowers).

III. Some flowers are not goats - True (Because, No goat is a flower, so Some flowers are not goats).

So, All conclusions follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the % signs and to balance the given equation.

42 % 7 % 5 % 10 % 3
questions.solution:
Given equation: 42 % 7 % 5 % 10 % 3.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) ÷, ×, =, × **

Given: 42 % 7 % 5 % 10 % 3 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**42 ÷ 7**__ × 5 = __**10 × 3**__ 

⇒ **__6__**__** ×**____** 5**__ = 30 

⇒ **30 = 30**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 2) ×, =, −, ÷ 

Given: 42 % 7 % 5 % 10 % 3 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**42 × 7**__ = 5 - __**10 ÷ 3**__ 

⇒ 294 = __**5 - 3.33**__

⇒ 294 ≠ 1.67

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) ÷, ×, =, −

Given: 42 % 7 % 5 % 10 % 3 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**42 ÷ 7**__ × 5 = __**10 - 3**__ 

⇒ __**6 × 5**__ = 7

⇒ 30 ≠ 7

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ×, ÷, =, − 

Given: 42 % 7 % 5 % 10 % 3 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 42 × __**7 ÷ 5**__ = __**10 - 3**__ 

⇒ __**42 × **____1.4__ = 7

⇒ 58.8 ≠ 7

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
A @ B means 'A is sister of B'.

A & B means 'A is brother of B'.

 

A # B means 'A is the wife of B'.

 

A^B means 'A is the mother of B'.

 

A + B means 'A is the father of B'.

 

If Z & P + N ^ Q # S & V + E @ L, then which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: P is maternal grandfather of Q.

questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 &
 #
 ^
 +
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: Z & P + N ^ Q # S & V + E @ L

It means: Z is the Brother of P, P is the Father of N, N is the Mother of Q, Q is the wife of S, S is the Brother of V, V is the Father of E, E is the Sister of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ff1c9b4d1cb03406b6a6c4bea81d098b9dfb31db018b62c1315999bf6ae3541.png] 

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) V is father of L - True.

Option 2) Q is mother of E - **False **(Q is the Paternal Aunt of E).

Option 3) P is maternal grandfather of Q - True.

Option 4) N is mother-in-law of S - True.

Here, Option 2 is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
